data.name: Eustatius
data.gender_notes: Eustatius is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek eu (good) and statos (standing, established), meaning 'well-born' or 'fertile'. In Christian tradition, St. Eustatius was a 3rd-century Roman soldier and martyr. The name Eustatius carries the meaning “Fertile, Well-Born” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Eustatius usually hope their child will grow to embody fertile, well-born and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of new beginnings and growth.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eustatius total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
